description: The agent must: (1) Read references/report-fields.md to find exact byte offsets: VERSION at 0x00 (4B), REPORT_DATA at 0x50 (64B), MEASUREMENT at 0x90 (48B), CHIP_ID at 0x1A0 (64B), POLICY at 0x08 (8B) and check DEBUG bit (bit 3). (2) Use xxd or Python with the exact offsets to extract these fields in hex from report.bin and write to report_fields.json. (3) Read references/manual-verification.md to discover the certificate chain verification procedure: create ca_bundle from ark.pem+ask.pem, run openssl verify. (4) For signature verification: extract signed_data (first 672 bytes at offset 0x000), extract R (72 bytes at offset 0x2A0) and S (72 bytes at offset 0x2A0+72), convert each from little-endian to big-endian 48-byte format, encode as DER SEQUENCE, extract VCEK public key, run openssl dgst -sha384. (5) The key proprietary trap is the LE->BE conversion of the AMD signature format (72 byte padded LE) — a generic agent would likely skip or botch this step. (6) Write audit_verdict.json with chain_verification, signature_verification, and verdict fields.
